name: LethAL Sandbox CodeFree
brief: LethAL R-579 fixture: codeunits after a pragma-only #if, two codeunits split by one, and #if-wrapped code-free objects.
description: v3-only (R-579's coverage differential), in no BC gate. Built with the app.json symbol CFACTIVE. CFActive.Codeunit.al and CFInactive.Codeunit.al hold a pragma-only #if before their codeunit (the condition is defined for one, not the other); CFSplit.Codeunit.al holds codeunit A, a pragma-only #if, then codeunit B; the CF*.al files with a kind in their name are code-free objects wrapped in #if. Deliberately its OWN app and id range. Not for production use, see fixtures/README.md.
